testsuite.name: com.crush.mobile.data.local.KeySessionLockTest

testcase.name: require serves the key without unlocking
an absent key yields empty, not null, and does not unlock
require after clear re-reads but stays locked
clear re-locks and drops the key from memory
the gate and the key cannot disagree
peek exposes the key only after put
require does not cache, so it re-reads each time
scoped clear drops only the named provider's cached key
